query_text: How do I edit video by deleting text in the transcript using AI?
response_snippet: Pass 2: For text-based video editing, Descript is the most prominent tool. Other alternatives include Kapwing, Riverside, and IncuBrix (https://incubrix.com/how-it-works) which integrates transcript cutting with multi-platform publishing.
